title: fix(rest)!: GET /meta/_drafts scopes by ?package= and refuses query parameters it does not read
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7uEuwPgByNvHxnrsUYacTB)_
Fixes #31490

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

1. 改了什么：`GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts`（REST 服务器路由与 runtime 分发器两处）改为通过 `metaItemPackageBinding` 读取 `?package=`，与 `GET /meta/:type`、`GET /meta/diagnostics` 一致；并声明封闭查询参数集 `package`、`type`，其他任何参数名（包括退役的 `packageId`）回 `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`。仓内所有调用方（client SDK、ui 的 MetadataClient、Console、dogfood、QA 清单）同步改发 `?package=`，SDK 选项名 `packageId` 不变。
2. 为什么改：该路由原来只读 `?packageId=`，`?package=ID` 被丢弃后返回所有包的草稿，状态 200；`?typ=view` 之类拼错的参数也同样被静默忽略（QA #31490）。
3. 风险与回滚：这是收窄（BREAKING，changeset 已写明 FROM `?packageId=ID` TO `?package=ID`）。仍发 `?packageId=` 的外部脚本会收到 400。仓外调用方（cloud）本会话无法测量，已写入 os-dev-report 的 open_questions。回滚即 revert 本 PR（服务端与 client、data-objectstack 一起回滚）。
4. 先看：`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` 新增的 `META_DRAFTS_QUERY_PARAMS` / `metaDraftsQueryRefusal`，再看 `packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts` 与 `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` 的 `_drafts` 处理，最后看两个测试文件末尾的 `[#31490]` describe。
5. 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-drafts-unknown-filter.test.ts` 与 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-drafts-unknown-type.test.ts`，预期 19 与 13 个用例全绿；把 rest 路由的读取改回 `req.query?.packageId` 后 3 个用例转红。
6. 需要你做的：无，合约评审通过后由席位落地。

## What changes

**The door, on both transports.** `GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts` is served by `RestServer` (`packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts`) and by the runtime `HttpDispatcher` twin (`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`). Both now ask the same decisions from `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`:

- **The package read.** Before: `packageId: req.query?.packageId || undefined`, so `?package=ID` was dropped and the drafts of every package came back `200`. After: `packageId: metaItemPackageBinding(req.query?.package)`, the binding `GET /meta/:type` and `GET /meta/diagnostics` already use. `?package=all` and an absent `package` list every package. A package that is neither installed nor bound to a pending draft is still refused by `listDrafts` itself with `400 INVALID_REQUEST`; that half is unchanged.
- **The closed query set.** New `META_DRAFTS_QUERY_PARAMS` (`package`, `type`) and `metaDraftsUnknownParamRefusal`, which give the nested `{ error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message } }` through `unknownQueryParamRefusalMessage`, the same sentence the list door answers. Recognition runs first, then arity (`refuseRepeatedQueryParams` / `metaQueryArityRefusal('drafts', …)`), then the bracketed-filter refusal. A bracketed `package[…]` or `type[…]` is left to its own located refusal; `packageId[]` is an unknown name.
- **Arity and bracketed tables.** `META_QUERY_ARITY_DOORS.drafts` is now `['package', 'type']`, and the `META_BRACKETED_FILTERS` drafts entry is respelled to `package`.
- **Exports.** `@objectstack/rest` exports `META_DRAFTS_QUERY_PARAMS` and `metaDraftsQueryRefusal` (the dispatcher's one call), so the closed set is spelled once.

**Every in-repo caller moves to `?package=`** in this PR:

- `@objectstack/client` `meta.listDrafts({ packageId })` (`packages/client/src/index.ts`).
- `@object-ui/data-objectstack` `MetadataClient.listDrafts({ packageId })` (`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts`).
- The Console: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/usePendingDrafts.ts` and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx` (three sites); a comment in `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`.
- Five dogfood tests and three items of `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json` (revisions bumped, history `#31490`).

The SDK option names (`packageId`) are unchanged, and so is the protocol's `ListDraftsRequest.packageId`; only the wire spelling moves.

**Clause-② read from the diff: `yes (narrowing)`.** A query that answered `200` (any unknown name, `?packageId=` included) now answers `400`. The widening half is the two new `@objectstack/rest` exports. The changeset carries the BREAKING section and the FROM `?packageId=ID` TO `?package=ID` remedy.

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/meta-drafts-unknown-filter.test.ts`: a new `[#31490]` describe driving the real route handler. `?package=ID` reaches `listDrafts` as the package; `?package=all` and (CONTROL) no query list every package; `packageId`, `typ`, an unknown name beside a known one and `packageId[]` are each refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` naming the parameter with `listDrafts` never called; an unknown name answers the status and code the list door answers; a repeated or bracketed `package` is refused `400`; CONTROL: an unknown `?package=` still reaches `listDrafts`, whose refusal stays `400 INVALID_REQUEST`. The `[#29180]` cases are respelled to `package`.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-drafts-unknown-type.test.ts`: the dispatcher twin of the same describe.
- Respelled to `package`: `meta-query-arity-doors.test.ts`, `rest-server-query-multiplicity.test.ts`, `rest-meta-diagnostics-unknown-params.test.ts` (title only), `packages/runtime/src/domains/dispatcher-query-arity.test.ts`, a label in `packages/objectql/src/package-disable-enforcement.test.ts`, `packages/client/src/meta-automation-descriptors.test.ts`, and the ui tests whose fakes read `searchParams.get('package')`.
- Twenty-four edited test files gain a module-top warm import (`@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/metadata` or `@objectstack/lint`), which `check:test-source-alias` asks of an edited test whose source loads that dependency lazily.

<details><summary>Ablation (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; both suites import src, so no build leg)</summary>

- **A, rest package read** back to `(req.query?.packageId as string | undefined) || undefined`. Mutation landed (blob 89e1a75a4e50 → 0b0c3363791c): `Tests 3 failed | 16 passed (19)` (the known package, `?package=ID`, the unknown-package control). Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **B, rest recognition removed** (`const unknownParam = undefined as any;`). Blob 89e1a75a4e50 → cb9b25d7957a: `Tests 5 failed | 14 passed (19)` (`packageId`, `typ`, the name beside a known one, `packageId[]`, list-door parity). Restored.
- **C, runtime package read** back to `query?.packageId || undefined`. Blob d6fd9f04356f → 25f92e2e345b: `Tests 1 failed | 12 passed (13)` (`?package=ID`). Restored.
- **D, runtime recognition** back to arity only (`metaQueryArityRefusal('drafts', query)`). Blob d6fd9f04356f → 15626b76d5ed: `Tests 4 failed | 9 passed (13)`. Restored.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Callers measured.** Every in-repo sender of `_drafts?packageId=` is migrated here; `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` has none. Callers outside this session's scope (cloud) are not measured, and the seat report lists that as an open question with a search string the cloud lane can run.
- **Historical mentions left as they are.** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-drafts-unknown-package.test.ts` and the history table in `packages/runtime/src/domains/dispatcher-query-arity.test.ts` describe the old `?packageId=` spelling as past behaviour; they are not callers.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` is private and gets no changeset; `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` changed only a comment.
